verification_status now uses VERIFIED / PARTIALLY_VERIFIED / UNVERIFIED / INACCESSIBLE. PARTIALLY_VERIFIED covers FreeScienceLessons videos (title and playlist matched, not watched) and Cognito, Oak and FuseSchool video lessons (page read, playback not tested).
suitability 'weak_fit_not_counted' marks a PMT question set that is kept in the file but not counted as practice coverage because it is very small or a weak fit for the subtopic. Nothing was deleted.
One record exists per (resource, subtopic_id). A resource that spans several subtopics has one record for each.
PMT Set B whole-topic Physics papers are mapped per question: coverage.relevant_questions lists the questions that belong to the subtopic and coverage.relevant_marks their marks.
PMT does not print the exam board inside its Physics Set A/B PDFs. They are hosted in PMT's AQA folder; the board is recorded as unconfirmed in verification_notes.
